title: Built Home Lab with Proxmox VE
description: Designed and deployed a full home lab environment using Proxmox VE. Configured multiple VMs including Windows Server 2022, Ubuntu Server, and pfSense firewall. Implemented VLAN segmentation and network monitoring.

title: Active Directory Domain Setup
description: Deployed a Windows Server 2022 Active Directory domain from scratch. Configured GPOs, OUs, user/group management, and DNS/DHCP services. Implemented security baselines following CIS benchmarks.

title: Automated Backup System with PowerShell
description: Developed a PowerShell script suite for automated daily backups, log rotation, and email alerting. Reduced manual admin overhead by 80% and achieved 99.9% backup success rate.

title: Linux Server Hardening & SSH Configuration
description: Hardened Ubuntu 22.04 LTS servers following NIST guidelines. Configured fail2ban, UFW firewall, SSH key-based authentication, and AIDE intrusion detection. Performed vulnerability scans with Lynis.

title: Network Monitoring with Zabbix
description: Deployed Zabbix 6.4 on Ubuntu Server to monitor 20+ network devices and servers. Created custom dashboards, alert thresholds, and escalation policies. Integrated with Telegram for real-time notifications.
